about: One sentence of the Nobel Committee's bio-bibliography, copied verbatim (bytes) from the page saved on 2026-10-08. We quote only the words in 'quoted'.
author: Anders Olsson, Chair of the Nobel Committee for Literature
sentence: With its brilliantly rendered meditation on Eros being the essence and driving force of the poem, the book draws heavily on a compound adjective from Sappho that defines Eros as pain and sweetness combined.
quoted: draws heavily on a compound adjective from Sappho
